name: Chaitanya Dadi
tagline: Eight years of turning messy data into reports people actually use. Now following everything that happens in AI, twice a day.
about: I'm a Power BI and data developer with more than eight years in the IT industry. I design data models, write DAX, build data pipelines and turn business questions into reports and dashboards that teams use every day.

This site is my corner of the internet: what I work with, what I'm learning, what I like, and an AI Hub that I built to keep up with the AI world. A Python script on GitHub Actions collects AI news, research and new tools every morning and evening and publishes them here.
